fact: A World Bank-financed tender invited bids to build a commercial register information system letting users submit registration filings online and consolidate local registers into the central register, with bids due 5 March 2020.
title: Recrutement d'une firme pour la mise en place du système d'information du registre de commerce de la Mauritanie
publisher: Projet Eco-Pôle Halieutique de Nouadhibou (via BETA Conseils)
